values: 5100 Whirlwind Slash var 5001 res 140000; 5200 Nightjar Slash var 5002 res 140100; 7000 Nightjar Reversal var 5002 res 140101; 5300 Ichimonji var 5003 res 140200; 7100 Ichimonji Double res 140201; 5400 Dragon Flash var 5004 res 140300; 5500 Ashina Cross var 5005 res 140400; 6100 One Mind var 5005 res 100286; 5600 Floating Passage var 5020 res 140500; 7200 Spiral Cloud var 5021 res 140501; 5700 Mortal Draw var 5007 res 140600; 7300 Empowered Mortal Draw res 140601; 5800 Senpou Leaping Kicks var 5008 res 140700; 7400 High Monk res 140701; 5900 Praying Strikes var 5009 res 140800; 7500 Exorcism res 140801; 6000 Shadowrush var 5010 res 140900; 7600 Shadowfall res 140901; 7700 Sakura Dance var 5030 res 141000. title: When the emblems are actually spent
summary: Emblems are not paid on the button press. A behavior row with wepCost 1 pays the cost when that attack fires. Rows named 'form consumption dummy' (judge 999) pay without an attack.
values: wepCost 1 judges: Dragon Flash 200 and 220; Ashina Cross/One Mind 200 and 210; Mortal Draw 999; Spiral Cloud 999; Shadowrush 215 (the leap hit); Sakura Dance 200. Rows with the same attack but no cost ('no form fee') carry the HP damage.
